y-m-80-05.title: Haddii aad isku lammaaneyso 10 jiridda samada iyo 12 jiridda dhulka, intee sano kadib ayay isla magacu soo noqdaa?
y-m-80-05.topic: Wareegga lixdanka ganji ee ay sameeyaan jiridda samada iyo jiridda dhulka
y-m-80-05.goal: Hubi oo sax qiyaastii koowaad (dhammaan 120 magac waa la isticmaalaa) adigoo isticmaalaya xog cusub, adigu samee lammaanaha aan la isticmaalin, oo sharax sababta wareeggu u yahay 60 sano xiriirka labada wareeg.
y-m-80-05.material:
Kalandarkii hore wuxuu sannad kasta siin jiray magac la yidhaahdo 'ganji'. 10-ka jiridda samada (갑 을 병 정 무 기 경 신 임 계) iyo 12-ka jiridda dhulka (자 축 인 묘 진 사 오 미 신 유 술 해) mid kastaa wuxuu nidaam ku wareegaa oo hal-hal ayaa loo lammaaneeyaa sannad kasta, sidaas darteed magacyadu waxay ku dhaqaaqaan hal tallaabo sannad kasta: 갑자, 을축, 병인, 정묘, ... Marka jiridda samada dhammaato, waxay ku noqotaa 갑, marka jiridda dhulka dhammaato-na waxay ku noqotaa 자. Tirooyinku waa 갑=1, 을=2, ..., 계=10, 자=1, 축=2, ..., 해=12.
Minseo ayaa yidhi, "Waxaa jira 10×12=120 magac, sidaas darteed waxay ku soo noqon doontaa magacii koowaad 갑자 kadib marka dhammaan 120 magac la isticmaalo."

y-m-80-11.topic: Cabbirrada muusiga iyo tamaraha: shanaadyada saafiga ah ee la isku dul saaray ma kulmaan octave?
y-m-80-11.goal: Barbar dhig cabbirrada tamaraha si aad u muujiso in sheegashada '12 shanaad = 7 octave' aanay sax ahaan sii jirin, fahan doodda khasnada-lammaanaha ee tan sharaxda kooban, oo barbar dhig laba jiho oo xal ah samaynta qalabka.
y-m-80-11.material:
Dhawaaqa codka waxaa lagu muujin karaa soo noqnoqda, xidhiidhka labada dhawaaq-na waxaa lagu barbar dhigaa saamiga soo noqnoqdooda. Aragtida hore, 'shanaad saafi ah' wuxuu leeyahay saamiga soo noqnoqda 3:2 (qoraalka sare waa 1.5 jeer), kor u qaadidda qoraal hal octave-na waxay laba-laabtaa soo noqnoqdiisa. Dad qaar ayaa rumaysnaa in haddii aad isku dul saarto 12 shanaad oo saafi ah qoraal ka bilaabma, aad dhex mari doonto dhammaan 12-ka qoraal oo aad ku soo noqon doonto isla qoraalka 7 octave oo sare.
Seou wuxuu yidhi, "(3/2) oo 12 jeer la dhufto waxay noqon doontaa sax ahaan 2 oo 7 jeer la dhufto. Markaas kiiboodhku si buuxda ayuu u xidhmayaa." (3/2 waa saddex badhood, 2⁷ na waa 2 oo 7 jeer la dhufto, taasoo ah 128)

y-m-80-09.title: Haddii ay jirto lambar hubin, ma qabsan karaa khalad qoris kasta?
y-m-80-09.topic: Lambarka hubinta ee lambarka buugga (ISBN) iyo ogaanshaha khaladaadka
y-m-80-09.goal: Ku hubi tusaalayaal noocyada khaladaadka gelinta ee lambarka hubintu hubaal qabsado iyo kuwa uu seegi karo, oo sharax xadkiisa adoo adigu samaynaya xaalad uu seego.
y-m-80-09.material:
Lambarka Buugaagta Caalamiga ah (ISBN-13) ee daboolka dambe ee buug waa 13 lambar. Ku dhufo 12-ka lambar ee ugu horreeya isku xigta 1, 3, 1, 3, ... oo isku dar dhammaantood si aad u hesho S, 13aad lambarkana (lambarka hubinta) waa lambarka 0 ilaa 9 ee wadarta ka dhigaya jibbaarka 10 marka lagu daro S.
Tusaale (lambar la sameeyay): haddii 12-ka lambar ee ugu horreeya yihiin 9 7 8 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9, markaas S = 9×1+7×3+8×1+1×3+2×1+3×3+4×1+5×3+6×1+7×3+8×1+9×3 = 133, lambarka hubintuna waa 7 (133+7=140).
Seojin wuxuu yiri, "Maadaama ay jirto lambar hubin, haddii aad lambarka si khaldan u qorto, waxay qabsan kartaa khalad kasta!"

y-m-80-13.s.s2.prompt: Haddii aad saxdo shaqada kore, tirada nidaamyadu waa 3^361, tirada aad hesho marka aad 3 ku dhufato naftiisa 361 jeer. Aan qiyaasno cabbirkeeda. 3 oo lagu dhufto 21 jeer waa 10460353203 (ku dhawaad 1.05×10^10), 361 = 21×17 + 4. Xadkee ayuu 3^361 ku jiraa?
y-m-80-13.s.s2.hint.0: Isbarbar dhig haddii 3^21 ay ka weyn tahay mise ka yar tahay 10^10, oo qor awood noocee ah oo 10 ah ayay ka gudubtaa marka 17 jeer la ku dhufto.
y-m-80-13.s.s2.hint.1: Qiyaas 3^21 sida 1.05×10^10 oo hubi cabbirka ku dhufashadiisa 17 jeer kor ka sidoo kale.
y-m-80-13.s.s2.r.a: Waxaad qiyaastay kor iyo hoosba adigoo ku dhufanaya 3^21 toddobo iyo toban jeer ka dibna 3^4.
y-m-80-13.s.s2.r.b: Maadaama 3^21 ay ka weyn tahay 10^10, ku dhufashada 17 jeer waxay ka gudubtaa 10^170. Qiyaastani aad bay uga yartahay taas.
y-m-80-13.s.s2.r.c: Maadaama 3^21 ay ka weyn tahay 10^10, ku dhufashada 17 jeer waxay ka gudubtaa 10^170. Qiyaastani waa ka yar tahay taas.
y-m-80-13.s.s2.r.d: Haddii aad ku dhufato 17 jeer adigoo og 3^21 inay ka yar tahay 1.05×10^10, ma ka gudubto 10^173. Qiyaastan sare aad bay u weyn tahay.
y-m-80-13.s.s3.prompt: 3^361 nidaamyada dhexdooda, qaar kuma dhici karaan ciyaar Go dhab ah (tirada nidaamyada dhab ahaan dhici kara waxaa la yaqaan inay tahay ku dhawaad 2.08×10^170). Sii hal nidaam oo aan dhici karin oo sharax sababta.
y-m-80-13.s.s3.hint.0: Ka fikir, marka loo eego xeerarka, haddii dhagax looxa ku yaal uu ku hari karo neef la'aan.
y-m-80-13.s.s3.hint.1: Nidaamka aad ka fikirtay, dib u shaqee waxa looxu u ekaa hal-ku-dhegga ugu dambeeya ka hor.
y-m-80-13.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma ka fikirtay haddii nidaamka aan bixiyey runtii aan dhici karin sababtoo ah xeerarka (aan suurtagal ahayn nidaam kasta oo lagu sameeyo)?
y-m-80-13.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma kala saartay farqiga u dhexeeya 'nidaamyada suurtagalka ah' iyo 'nidaamyada dhab ahaan dhaca'?
y-m-80-13.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma qortay adigoo og in hal tusaale lid ku ah ay ku filan tahay?
